title: Sensor Driver Factory: unique_ptr, custom deleters
hints: makeDriver: `if (kind == "lidar") return std::make_unique<LidarDriver>();`. A unique_ptr<Derived> converts to unique_ptr<Driver> implicitly.
takeFastest: find the index with std::max_element, `auto out = std::move(ds[i]);`, then erase that (now null) slot.
DeviceCloser::operator() just calls dev_close(h). unique_ptr never calls the deleter for nullptr.
openShared: `std::shared_ptr<DeviceHandle>(h, dev_close)`. The deleter is type-erased into the control block, so it's not part of the type.
